levels.name: Member
levels.privilege: Can download, upload torrents；Ratio effects availability of new torrents

levels.name: Sharer
levels.privilege: Can download, upload torrents；Ratio has no effect on availability of new torrents；Notification and highlighting of new comments

levels.name: Distributor
levels.privilege: Can download, upload torrents；Ratio has no effect on availability of new torrents；Notification and highlighting of new comments；Can view peers on torrents；Can view user list of who completed downloading a torrent

levels.name: Uploader
levels.privilege: user who uploads new content to the site on a regular basis

levels.name: Uploader+
levels.privilege: uploader who has a low freeleech ratio
